text:
incident-bot: Pager alert — increased 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Trigger: threshold breach (5m error rate > 10%). Pager routed to Maya.

Maya (oncall): I’m on it. Seeing elevated 500s across runtime pool nodes rtx-*. Starting with logs + redis/KV checks.

Maya (oncall): quick dump: most 500s correlate with large batch requests (batch_size>=64) and longer seq lengths.

Kyle (Runtime Eng): noted. Recent kernel rollout to rtx-3 last night? rolling restart might help. Will check recent deploys.

Jon (SRE): please start a status page draft so we can push something ASAP. Comms + support need copy for customers.

Alex (Comms): drafting initial status page entry now. Will post in thread for review before publish.

Alex (Comms): DRAFT (initial):
```
Investigating — Generation endpoints degraded (us-west-2)

Status: We are investigating elevated error rates affecting the hosted Generation API at /v1/generate in the us-west-2 region.
Impact: Some requests may return 500 errors or time out. We estimate ~10-20% of generation requests may be impacted.
Scope: Hosted API only; Dedicated and Private deployments not affected by this issue.
Action: Engineers are investigating root cause and applying mitigations. We will post updates every 15 minutes.
Next update: in 15 minutes.
```

Priya (PM): please add "workarounds" section for customers: retry with exponential backoff, reduce batch_size to <=8, or route to us-east-1 for critical traffic.

Alex (Comms): updated draft with workaround. New snippet: 
```
Workarounds: If you encounter errors, we recommend:
- Retry with exponential backoff
- Reduce batch_size to <=8
- Route traffic to us-east-1 as a fallback
```

Emma (Support): Can we include a short support blurb customers can paste into tickets? e.g., "We're aware of generation errors in us-west-2; try reducing batch_size or routing to us-east-1."

Alex (Comms): adding support blurb.

Maya (oncall): quick customer-impact assessment: about 1200 requests/min historically; 150-250 reqs/min failing during peak window (10:12-10:28 UTC). No data loss; requests either 500 or time out.

Jon (SRE): ok. I recommend publishing initial 'investigating' update now. Maya + Kyle will run rolling restart of rtx-3 nodes and monitor error rate.

Maya (oncall): starting rolling restart now (command):
```
./deploy/tools/restart-runtime --pool rtx-3 --rolling --grace 30s
```

Kyle (Runtime Eng): I'm watching logs, will tail Kinesis and node metrics. ETA 8m for first herd to come back.

Alex (Comms): final check before publish?

Priya (PM): :+1: make sure to mention mitigation in the second update if restart helps.

Jon (SRE): Approved. Publish when ready.

Alex (Comms): Publishing initial status page update. Preview: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/preview/1772509876

Alex (Comms): :white_check_mark: Published initial update to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1772509876

Emma (Support): posted canned response in Support → "Generation errors in us-west-2" template. Link to status page included.

[15m later] Maya (oncall): 15m update: after rolling restart, error rate dropped from ~16% -> ~4%. Some residual 500s on heavy batches. Continuing monitoring.

Alex (Comms): DRAFT (15m update):
```
Update — Mitigation in progress

Status: Error rate has decreased following a rolling restart of runtime nodes in us-west-2. We continue to see a small percentage of failed requests, primarily with large batch_size and long sequences.
Impact: ~4% of requests affected at time of update.
Action: Engineers continue to monitor. We recommend reducing batch_size as a temporary workaround.
Next update: in 15 minutes or as events warrant.
```

Jon (SRE): looks good. Publish.

Alex (Comms): Published 15m update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1772509876/updates/2

Maya (oncall): 30m update: error rate fluctuating between 2-5%. Memory use on a few nodes still creeping pre-restart levels. Kyle digging into heap profiles.

Kyle (Runtime Eng): found suspicious KV cache growth during large-batch workloads. Running a patch that trims cached prefixes older than 5m. Rolling patch across pool.

Priya (PM): any expected customer-visible impact from the patch?

Kyle (Runtime Eng): patch is lightweight; should not cause additional errors. I'll roll with 1% canary then full.

Alex (Comms): DRAFT (30m update):
```
Update — Patch rollout underway

Status: Additional mitigations deployed to trim KV cache growth and stabilize memory usage. Error rates have stabilized between 2-5%.
Impact: Small subset of heavy-batch requests may still fail.
Action: Engineers rolling patch; no action required from customers beyond the existing workaround.
Next update: when patch completes or sooner.
```

Alex (Comms): Published 30m update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1772509876/updates/3

[~1h later] Maya (oncall): Resolved: error rate returned to baseline (~0.2%) at 11:40 UTC after full patch rollout and node restarts. No customer data lost.

Alex (Comms): DRAFT (resolved):
```
Resolved — Generation endpoints restored (us-west-2)

Status: The issue impacting the Generation API in us-west-2 has been resolved. Error rates returned to normal following a patch to trim KV cache growth and rolling restarts of the runtime pool.
Impact: Affected customers may have seen 500s or timeouts for a window (10:12–11:40 UTC). Estimated affected request rate peaked at ~15-20% and reduced to baseline after mitigation.
Root cause: Excessive KV cache growth during heavy-batch workloads caused memory pressure and 5xx errors.
Action: Patch deployed and nodes restarted. Postmortem scheduled.
```

Jon (SRE): Approved for publish.

Alex (Comms): Published resolved notice: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1772509876/resolved

Emma (Support): Updated customer-facing ticket template with resolved language and link to status page.

Priya (PM): Scheduling postmortem doc. Ops: include timeline, root cause, and long-term mitigation (auto-trim cache and backpressure on large-batch requests).

Maya (oncall): handing back to regular rotation. Leaving notes in oncall handoff: restart commands run, patch rolled, follow-up next week for permanent fix.

incident-bot: Incident closed on status page. Postmortem doc link to follow. :memo:
